Listen to the pain in his voice. The endless suffering of Palestinians in Gaza. ENOUGH IS ENOUGH! Thousands of tents broke overnight, and this young boy in Zaytoun neighborhood is one of them. The Sameer Project is getting hundreds of calls and messages asking for support, and we don’t have the funds to do it! The military occupation closed the Egyptian borders a few days ago, and there are no tents or tarps coming in. War profiteers supported by the military occupation are hoarding tents and tarps, and hiking the prices making it impossible for anyone to afford them. Our choices are to feel hopeless and angry, or mobilize and help as much as we can. The Sameer Project chooses the latter but we NEED your urgent help. Donate urgently to the General Fund and share the crisis in Gaza with everyone you know.

She was hit by a car right in front of my home. She’s the eighth out of my nine cats that I’ve lost. Sometimes it feels like life just keeps finding new ways to break what’s left of my heart.. #rip #rest #loss #🐾

Inside the Israeli Parliament (Knesset) Palestinian lawmakers Ahmed Tibi and Talab Abu Arar staged a protest by reciting the *Adhan* (call to prayer). This was in response to a legislative proposal that sought to ban the use of loudspeakers for the *Adhan* at mosques. Students at the London School of Economics (LSE) raised Palestinian flags and expressed solidarity with Palestine as part of the International Youth Strike Against War in London. Around 200 students from LSE and King's College London (KCL) took part in a march towards Trafalgar Square, joining a wider anti-war demonstration organised by the Stop the War Coalition, which brought together more than 1,000 participants. The mobilisation followed an international anti-war conference held in June, and formed part of broader student and public opposition to war and solidarity with the Palestinian people.
